messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing, marked by significant shifts in both development and deployment. Open-source agent frameworks have officially hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling recently across the broader tech industry. Concurrently, startups are quietly replacing traditional hand-coded orchestration with dynamic, model-driven agents. As these autonomous systems continue to evolve, tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for evaluating frontier models. Furthermore, multi-agent swarms are moving beyond mere demonstrations into strictly regulated enterprise workflows. To support this growing complexity and ensure operational safety, new observability standards are emerging, enabling comprehensive end-to-end tracing of agent decisions.
